correctness.rationale: The scalar inequality |a+b|^p+|a-b|^p>=2(|a|^p+|b|^p) is obtained by convexity applied to the squared terms; for p>2 equality forces ab=0. Integrating coordinatewise gives necessity r^p+s^p<=1. For uncountable Gamma, a finite family has countable total support, so one coordinate outside it gives exact disjointness even on the boundary. For countably infinite Gamma and strict inequality, a tail coordinate makes all finitely many x-values small enough. Boundary failure follows by choosing a full-support unit vector x: equality in both signs would force the witness y to be coordinatewise disjoint from x, hence zero. At p=2 the parallelogram identity gives the exact disk r^2+s^2<=1. The proof is infinite-dimensional and does not infer necessity from finite sampling.
